title: common task-coordinate manifold tournament
hypothesis: For four related digit-rotation tasks trained from one common base, a shared low-rank task-delta basis plus per-task codes can preserve task quality with fewer serialized bytes than independent checkpoints and outperform random intrinsic subspaces; Mirror coordinates must add value beyond native PCA/task-vector coordinates to support a Mirror-specific claim.
physical_object: One pooled base MLP, four task-delta vectors, and candidate shared bases
mirror_coordinate: Per-task coefficient vectors in a shared basis; Mirror coordinate is tested as identity encoding of native PCA coefficients
logical_multiplicity: Four task-specific classifiers, one per rotation domain
controls: shared base plus full task vectors
random orthonormal intrinsic bases at ranks 1,2,3,4
native task coefficients versus Mirror coefficient encoding

development.selection_metric: mean validation task NLL; base and task learning rates selected from .03 and .1

data.split: fixed stratified source-image 60/20/20; split seeds 420 and 421

training.task_finetune: 20 epochs per task from the common base
training.task_vectors: task model minus common base, computed from train-only task models
training.SVD_basis: right singular vectors of the 4xP task-delta matrix; task codes are orthogonal projections
training.random_basis: seeded orthonormal Gaussian bases with codes projected from the same task deltas

paid_objects: full task deltas for arithmetic control

success_gate: At some rank <=3, learned SVD task-coordinate bank has mean task accuracy within 2 pp of independent experts, improves actual serialized bytes by at least 25% versus independent bank, and beats same-rank random basis by at least 5 pp; any Mirror-specific claim additionally requires a result beyond native coefficient coding.
failure_gate: No rank meets all quality/storage gates, random basis matches, task soup dominates, or Mirror encoding aliases native coefficients. Report the best non-Mirror frontier separately.
boundaries: Four rotated Digits tasks form a small related-task benchmark, not a natural-task or language-model result.
PCA basis and task codes are native controls, not Mirror inventions.
Four task IDs or coefficient vectors do not count as independent capacity without heldout task quality.
No new hyperparameters are selected from fresh task test metrics.

amendments.reason: After the fresh run, add the actual serialized payload size for the model-soup control, which was listed in controls but not emitted in the initial result JSON. This is accounting only; training settings and metrics are unchanged.
